# Progressive Transportation Services

> Progressive Transportation Services is a local junk removal, moving and delivery, and furniture assembly company serving Phoenix and the East Valley in Arizona. It is a service brand operated by Saguaro Transportation Services.

Customers can book online or request an estimate. Junk-removal photo estimates are preliminary ballpark estimates; the crew confirms a clear price before work begins. The business serves Phoenix, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Tempe, Scottsdale, and nearby communities.

Contact: (480) 351-0291. USDOT 4421119. MC-1763629.

## Services

- [Junk Removal](https://www.progressive-junk.xyz/junk-removal): Furniture and appliance removal, mattresses, garage and estate cleanouts, yard debris, hot tubs, and e-waste. Upfront volume-based pricing, with special handling for heavy materials.
- [Local Moving and Delivery](https://www.progressive-junk.xyz/moving): Local home and apartment moves, in-home furniture moves, single-item delivery, loading and unloading, and senior downsizing.
- [Furniture Assembly](https://www.progressive-junk.xyz/assembly-handyman): Flat-pack furniture, beds, dressers, desks, shelving, patio furniture, and exercise equipment, including patient service for seniors.
